credentialFormats.description: A link for uploading a renewed SAML signing certificate.

credentialFormats.label: Admin Portal link: Audit Logs
credentialFormats.description: A link for viewing and exporting the organization's audit logs.

credentialFormats.label: Admin Portal link: Log Streams
credentialFormats.description: A link for streaming audit logs to the organization's SIEM.

credentialFormats.label: Admin Portal link: Bring Your Own Key

fields.label: External ID
fields.description: Your own identifier for this organization. Leave blank to clear it.

fields.label: Domains
fields.description: Verified and pending organization domains, comma-separated.

outputs.label: Organization ID
outputs.description: The org_… id used in every organization-scoped API call.

resourceTypes.description: An AuthKit / User Management user. Environment-level: one user can belong to many organizations through organization memberships.

fields.label: Email
fields.description: The user's sign-in email. Editing it changes the address WorkOS authenticates.

fields.label: External ID
fields.description: Your own identifier for this user. Leave blank to clear it.

fields.label: Locale
fields.description: Preferred locale for emails and hosted pages, e.g. en-GB.

outputs.label: User ID
outputs.description: The user_… id used in membership and invitation calls.

resourceTypes.description: A user's membership in an organization, with their role. Can be deactivated and reactivated without losing role assignments.

fields.label: Role
fields.description: Role slug, e.g. `member` or `admin`. Edit to reassign the role.

fields.label: All Roles
fields.description: Every role slug the membership holds, comma-separated.

fields.label: Directory Managed
fields.description: True when Directory Sync owns this membership.

resourceTypes.description: An email invitation into an organization. Pending invitations can be resent or revoked; deleting one revokes it.

outputs.label: Accept URL
outputs.description: The URL the recipient accepts through. Contains the invitation token, so treat it like a credential.

resourceTypes.description: A Single Sign-On connection between an organization and its identity provider (Okta SAML, Azure SAML, Google OAuth, generic OIDC, …). Configured via the dashboard or an Admin Portal link; renamable and deletable here.
A Directory Sync directory (Okta SCIM, Entra/Azure SCIM, Google Workspace, Workday, …). Owns the synced directory users and groups. Set up via the dashboard or Admin Portal; deletable here.
A user synced from a directory provider. Read-only; the IdP owns the record.
A group synced from a directory provider. Read-only; the IdP owns the group.
An environment role, assignable to organization memberships and invitations by slug. The API has no delete; remove roles in the WorkOS dashboard.

fields.label: Permissions
fields.description: Permission slugs assigned to the role, comma-separated.

resourceTypes.description: An HTTPS endpoint subscribed to WorkOS events (authentication, memberships, Directory Sync, SSO connections, …). The signing secret is exposed as a sensitive output.

fields.label: Events
fields.description: Subscribed event types, comma-separated, e.g. user.created, dsync.user.updated.

outputs.label: Signing Secret
outputs.description: The whsec_… secret used to verify webhook payload signatures.

resourceTypes.description: A domain claimed by an organization. Add one here, publish the TXT record it shows, then verify it.
A custom role scoped to a single organization. Assign it to that organization's memberships; delete it when it is no longer used.

fields.label: Permissions
fields.description: Permission slugs assigned to the role, comma-separated.

resourceTypes.description: A permission that roles and API keys grant by slug, such as `widgets:read`. System permissions are managed by WorkOS and cannot be deleted.
An API key your app issued to an organization with WorkOS API Keys. Create one with permissions and an optional expiry, expire it, or delete it.

outputs.label: API Key
outputs.description: The full key, returned only when it is created here. WorkOS never shows it again.

resourceTypes.description: A feature flag in this environment. Turn it on or off and target organizations or users here; define new flags in the WorkOS dashboard.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Whether the flag is active in this environment.

fields.label: Default value
fields.description: What users and organizations outside every targeting rule receive.

resourceTypes.description: A named set of an organization's memberships. Add and remove members here; roles assigned to the group apply to every member.

manifest.description: Communications APIs. Track Twilio spend by product, usage category and subaccount, watch the account balance, chart daily message and call volume, and manage phone numbers, messaging and Verify services, TwiML apps, subaccounts, usage triggers and API keys.
manifest.author: Infrawrench

credentialFields.label: Account SID
credentialFields.description: Your main account's SID, shown on the Twilio Console home page. It starts with AC. Use the main account, not a subaccount, to see spend for every subaccount.

credentialFields.label: API Key SID
credentialFields.description: Recommended: an API key created under Account, API keys and tokens (it starts with SK). A Standard key lists resources and reads main-account spend; a Main key can also manage subaccounts and keys and read the balance. Leave blank to use the auth token.

credentialFields.label: API Key Secret
credentialFields.description: The secret shown once when the API key was created.

credentialFields.label: Auth Token
credentialFields.description: Only needed without an API key. The auth token is the only credential Twilio lets read each subaccount's spend and phone numbers individually, so use it for per-subaccount cost.

credentialFields.label: CA Certificate (optional)
credentialFields.description: PEM-encoded trust anchor for verifying the API endpoint. Use this for self-hosted vendor instances or corporate TLS-intercepting proxies. Leave blank to use the operating system's default trust store.

resourceTypes.description: The Twilio account the credentials belong to: balance, spend this month and last by product and usage category, and daily message, call and spend volume.
A Twilio subaccount. Rename it, suspend or reactivate it, see its spend and volume, or close it for good. Managing subaccounts needs the auth token or a Main API key.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Up to 64 characters.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Suspended subaccounts cannot make calls or send messages but keep their phone numbers, which are still billed. To close a subaccount for good, delete it.

resourceTypes.description: A phone number the account rents, with its capabilities, monthly price and where its calls and messages go. Edit its webhooks, or release it to stop paying for it.

orphanRule.reason: Phone number has no voice or messaging webhook, TwiML app, SIP trunk or messaging service, so nothing answers it, but it is still billed every month

fields.label: Friendly Name
fields.description: Up to 64 characters.

fields.label: Monthly Price
fields.description: Twilio's current monthly price for this country and number type.

fields.label: Voice Webhook URL
fields.description: Called when the number receives a call. Ignored while a TwiML app or trunk handles voice.

fields.label: Messaging Webhook URL
fields.description: Called when the number receives a message. Ignored while the number belongs to a messaging service that handles inbound itself.

resourceTypes.description: A messaging service: a pool of senders with shared inbound handling, delivery callbacks and sending features. Create, edit and delete them here.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Up to 64 characters.

fields.label: Inbound Webhook URL
fields.description: Called when a sender in the service receives a message.

fields.label: Sticky Sender
fields.description: Keep sending to a recipient from the same number.

fields.label: Smart Encoding
fields.description: Replace Unicode look-alikes so messages stay in cheaper GSM-7 segments.

fields.label: MMS Converter
fields.description: Send MMS as SMS with a link where the recipient cannot receive MMS.

fields.label: Area Code Geomatch
fields.description: Prefer a sender with the recipient's area code.

fields.label: Validity Period (seconds)
fields.description: How long a queued message may wait before Twilio drops it, 1 to 36000. Blank uses Twilio's default.

resourceTypes.description: A Verify service that sends one-time codes by SMS, voice, email or WhatsApp. Shows the last 30 days of verification attempts and conversion rate; create, edit and delete them here.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Shown in the verification message, so use your product's name. Up to 30 characters.

fields.label: Code Length
fields.description: Digits in the code, 4 to 10.

fields.label: Look Up Numbers First
fields.description: Run a Lookup on the number before sending (billed as a Lookup).

resourceTypes.description: A TwiML application: a reusable set of voice and messaging webhooks that phone numbers and Voice SDK clients point at.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Up to 64 characters.

resourceTypes.description: A Twilio usage trigger: Twilio calls a webhook when a usage category crosses a threshold, once per day, month or year. With Total spend, Price and Monthly it is a budget alert that Twilio itself enforces.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Up to 64 characters.

fields.label: Webhook URL
fields.description: Twilio calls this when the trigger fires. An Infrawrench workflow's webhook URL works, and lets the workflow alert through Slack, Teams or paging.

resourceTypes.description: A Twilio API key on the main account. Listing and managing keys needs the auth token or a Main API key; deleting one revokes it immediately.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Up to 64 characters.

outputs.label: Secret
outputs.description: Only ever returned when the key is created.
